svg.aria-label: DigOps unified logo · Dig + diamond mark + Ops with Buy · Make · Sell tagline
svg.title: DigOps · unified logo · v1
svg.desc: Primary brand impression — single unified glyph where the 45° rotated diamond mark sits between "Dig" and "Ops" as the navy→sun-gold color hinge. Mark's navy elements continue from "Dig"; mark's sun-gold center anchors "Ops". Vollkorn Bold 96px navy "Dig" + 96×96 mark (9-cell rotated lattice) + Vollkorn Bold 96px sun-gold "Ops" + stone rule + Lora italic 18px tagline "Buy · Make · Sell". v1 lock 2026-05-19 PM (bp5 Phase 1 carve · v2.2 unified-logo arrival · supersedes v2.1 horizontal lockup which is archived to _archive-2026-05-19-v1/). v2.4 (2026-05-25): diamond spacing balanced — mark optically centered between "Dig" and "Ops" ink with equal clear-space each side (mark translate 320→328, Ops 416→427, rule + tagline recentred), correcting the v2.2/2.3 cramp into "g". Prior at _archive-2026-05-25-pre-v2.4/.
